scope: Observe the actual post-revocation platform UPDATE at a fixture-owned database barrier, then reject only the synthetic disconnected projection and observe complete worker cleanup
before_start_sql: CREATE FUNCTION issuance_service.synthetic_reject_disconnect_marker() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'synthetic disconnect marker write failure' USING ERRCODE='P0001'; END $$

CREATE TRIGGER synthetic_reject_disconnect_marker BEFORE UPDATE OF connection_config ON issuance_service.canvas_platforms FOR EACH ROW WHEN (OLD.id='platform-review' AND NEW.connection_config->>'oauth_status'='disconnected') EXECUTE FUNCTION issuance_service.synthetic_reject_disconnect_marker()
barrier_sql: LOCK TABLE issuance_service.canvas_platforms IN SHARE MODE
blocked_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname=current_database() AND pid<>pg_backend_pid() AND state='active' AND wait_event_type='Lock' AND query ILIKE '%UPDATE%canvas_platforms%'
